package.name: control_pkg
package.description: Waypoint-following trajectory controller for TurtleBot3 Burger. Reads target waypoints from a YAML config, subscribes to /odometry/bt_fused (outdoor) or /odom (indoor), and publishes velocity commands to /cmd_vel. Implements always-forward pursuit law, door guard logic, jump filtering, and two-phase stuck recovery (backup + rotate).
